notes: Generated 18 test methods covering all 15 confirmed intents across 4 DDD layers. Domain tests cover Building entity constructor validation (valid properties, null/empty name, null/empty color, zero/negative dimensions, invalid areaId, boundary values). Application tests cover BuildingService.AddBuildingAsync (successful add, duplicate detection, area validation). Infrastructure tests cover SqlBuildingRepository (AddAsync persistence, ExistsByNameAsync true/false cases). Presentation tests cover AddBuildingHandler (201 Created, 409 Conflict, 400 Bad Request responses). All tests follow established patterns with AAA structure, Assert.Multiple for multiple assertions, and proper Moq usage.
